verdicts.reason: A puts 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' below the headline, which reverses the reading order. Its subhead is squeezed into a narrow three-line column, the RSVP button is the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS pills so the CTA gets lost among them, the right third is jammed with tiny URL and legal text, and the broken-image placeholder is still visible. B keeps the right order (presents, headline, subhead) and groups the date, badges and CTA into clear columns, but the logo is tiny and hard to read, the RSVP button is small and weak, the legal and date text is unreadably small at 90 px, and the placeholder still appears.
